_comment: Example sqli credentials. Copy to $SQLI_HOME/.sqli/sqli_credentials.json (global) and/or <project>/.sqli/sqli_credentials.json. Keyed by env name; each object may carry `password` (and any option, e.g. `user`). Kept separate from sqli_config.json so config can be committed while secrets stay out of version control — gitignore this file. Closer project layers override farther ones and the global; an explicit CLI -p still wins over all. Only the selected env's (-E NAME) secrets are read. Passwords are never logged.
